name: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) with Parametric Motion Field for 4D-CT
aliases: Warp Template Scene with Motion Field
definition: A reconstruction pipeline that jointly estimates a static scene template via an Implicit Neural Representation (INR) and a parametric motion field to reconstruct a 4D dynamic scene from limited-view sinogram data without training data.
summary: This method reconstructs 4D-CT from limited-view sinograms without phase data by jointly optimizing a static Implicit Neural Representation and a parametric motion field.
